# Simulation to compare far() and plug-in forecasting

```{r}
grid_forecast <- expand.grid(
  T = c(500, 1000),
  d = c(1),
  ar_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  ma_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  model = c("1_0", "0_1", "1_1", "2_0")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 1L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 0L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 2L
    ),
    q = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 0L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 0L
    ),
    ar_strength = dplyr::if_else(p == 0, 0, ar_strength),
    ma_strength = dplyr::if_else(q == 0, 0, ma_strength)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength)


grid_forecast <- data.frame(
  T = 500,
  d = 1,
  p = 1L,
  q = 0L,
  ar_strength = 0.8,
  ma_strength = 0.8
)

plan(multisession, workers = 10)
handlers("progress")

forecast_sim <- parallel_sim_forecasting_FARMA_compare_compact(
  n_rep = 100,
  grid = grid_forecast,
  h_max = 10,
  train_ratio = 0.6,
  valid_ratio = 0.2,
  alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
  window_types = c("expanding", "fixed"),
  Npc = 1,
  no_grid = 101,
  far_pve = 0.95,
  fracdiff_trim = 150
)
```

### Plots of RMSE ratio
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)

plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

make_forecast_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                        metric_col = "RMSE",
                                        method_col = "method",
                                        farma_label = "FARMA",
                                        far_label = "FAR(1)") {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }

  wide_farma <- intersect(c("RMSE_farma", "rmse_farma", "RMSE_FARMA"), names(df))

  wide_far <- intersect(c("RMSE_far", "rmse_far", "RMSE_FAR"), names(df))

  if (length(wide_farma) > 0 &&
      length(wide_far) > 0) {
    out <- df %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[wide_farma[1]]] /
               .data[[wide_far[1]]])

  } else {
    if (!metric_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find metric column. Change `metric_col`.")
    }

    if (!method_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find method column. Change `method_col`.")
    }

    group_vars <- intersect(
      c(
        T_name,
        "h",
        "window_type",
        "ar_strength",
        "ma_strength",
        "p_true",
        "q_true",
        "d",
        "d_true"
      ),
      names(df)
    )

    out <- df %>%
      mutate(
        method_use = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])), "farma") ~ farma_label,

          str_detect(
            tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])),
            "far\\(1\\)|far1|far_1|plugin|far$"
          ) ~ far_label,

          TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[method_col]])
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars)), method_use) %>%
      summarise(metric_value = mean(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = method_use, values_from = metric_value)

    if (!farma_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FARMA method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }

    if (!far_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FAR(1) method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }

    out <- out %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[farma_label]] /
               .data[[far_label]])
  }

  if (!"ar_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ar_strength <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"ma_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ma_strength <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"window_type" %in% names(out)) {
    out$window_type <- "Window"
  }

  psi_vals <- sort(unique(out$ar_strength[is.finite(out$ar_strength)]))

  nu_vals <- sort(unique(out$ma_strength[is.finite(out$ma_strength)]))

  out %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),

      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),

      model_label = paste0("FARFIMA(", p_true, ",1,", q_true, ")"),

      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),

      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",

        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",

        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),

      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),

      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(0,2)",
          "(1,1)",
          "(2,1)",
          "(1,2)",
          "(2,2)"
        )
      ),

      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", psi_vals)),

      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", nu_vals))
    )
}

get_T_cols <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  cols <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(cols)) {
    stop("Not enough colours for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(cols[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  if (length(window_levels) > length(ltys)) {
    stop("Not enough line types for the number of windows.")
  }

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  if (length(window_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of windows.")
  }

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

plot_forecast_ratio_one_model <- function(df,
                                          model_show,
                                          title = NULL,
                                          show_legend = FALSE,
                                          value_col = "rmse_ratio",
                                          y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }

  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)

  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]

  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = .data[[value_col]],
      group = interaction(T_factor, window_type),
      colour = T_factor,
      linetype = window_type,
      shape = window_type
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_window_shapes(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      colour = "Sample size T",
      linetype = "Window",
      shape = "Window"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) {
        "top"
      } else {
        "none"
      },

      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",

      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold"),

      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),

      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),

      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )

  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }

  g
}

make_forecast_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
           window_type = droplevels(window_type))

  T_levels <- levels(df_use$T_factor)
  W_levels <- levels(df_use$window_type)

  x_title <- 0
  x_item_start <- 3.0
  item_gap <- 3.7

  line_length <- 0.75
  text_gap <- 0.45

  T_df <- tibble(
    T_factor = factor(T_levels, levels = T_levels),

    x_symbol = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,

    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,

    y = 1.00,

    label = paste0("T = ", T_levels)
  )

  W_df <- tibble(
    window_type = factor(W_levels, levels = W_levels),

    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,

    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,

    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(W_levels) - 1) *
      item_gap,

    y = 0.55,
    label = W_levels
  )

  xmax <- max(c(T_df$x_text + 1.8, W_df$x_text + 2.2), na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 1.00,
      label = "Sample size T",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_symbol, y = y, colour = T_factor),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 0.55,
      label = "Window",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = W_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        linetype = window_type
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = W_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = window_type),
      size = legend_point_size,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = W_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df_use)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df_use)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_window_shapes(df_use)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax),
                    ylim = c(0.35, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

make_forecast_legend_manual_core <- make_forecast_legend_manual

combine_four_forecast_models_shared_axes <- function(
    df,
    models,
    titles,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 16,
    height = 12,
    y_limits = NULL,
    value_col = "rmse_ratio",
    y_axis_label = "RMSE ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)") {
  assemble_ratio_panel_grid(
    df = df,
    models = models,
    titles = titles,
    value_col = value_col,
    plot_model = plot_forecast_ratio_one_model,
    legend = make_forecast_legend_manual(df),
    y_axis_label = y_axis_label,
    file_name = file_name,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    y_limits = y_limits,
    common_y = TRUE,
    shared_label_size = shared_label_size
  )
}
```

### Table of RMSE, MAE, and WIS

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

ideal_table_keys <- c(
  "n", "d_true", "ar_strength", "ma_strength", "p_true", "q_true",
  "window_type", "h"
)

ideal_wis_wide <- ideal_wis %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
    window_type == "expanding"
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(ideal_table_keys), method, WIS)

if (nrow(ideal_wis_wide) == 0L ||
    any(!is.finite(ideal_wis_wide$WIS)) ||
    any(!ideal_wis_wide$method %in% c("far", "farma"))) {
  stop("Ideal WIS table data are missing or invalid.", call. = FALSE)
}

ideal_wis_duplicates <- ideal_wis_wide %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(ideal_table_keys, "method")))) %>%
  summarise(key_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(key_count != 1L)

if (nrow(ideal_wis_duplicates) > 0L) {
  stop("Ideal WIS table keys are not unique.", call. = FALSE)
}

ideal_wis_wide <- ideal_wis_wide %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = WIS,
    names_prefix = "WIS_"
  )

if (!all(c("WIS_far", "WIS_farma") %in% names(ideal_wis_wide))) {
  stop("Ideal WIS table requires FAR and FARMA values.", call. = FALSE)
}

forecast_table <- forecast_res$ratio_summary %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
    window_type == "expanding"
  ) %>%
  left_join(ideal_wis_wide, by = ideal_table_keys) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = paste0("$(", p_true, ",1,", q_true, ")$"),
    Dependence = paste0("$(", ar_strength, ",", ma_strength, ")$")
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    n,
    p_true,
    q_true,
    ar_strength,
    ma_strength,
    h
  )

if (nrow(forecast_table) == 0L ||
    any(!is.finite(forecast_table$WIS_far)) ||
    any(!is.finite(forecast_table$WIS_farma))) {
  stop("Ideal forecasting table has missing or invalid WIS values.", call. = FALSE)
}

forecast_table <- forecast_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    min_RMSE = min(
      c(RMSE_far, RMSE_farma),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_MAE = min(
      c(MAE_far, MAE_farma),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_WIS = min(
      c(WIS_far, WIS_farma),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RMSE_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(RMSE_far, min_RMSE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_far),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_far)
    ),

    RMSE_Plugin_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(RMSE_farma, min_RMSE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_farma),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_farma)
    ),

    MAE_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(MAE_far, min_MAE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", MAE_far),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", MAE_far)
    ),

    MAE_Plugin_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(MAE_farma, min_MAE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", MAE_farma),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", MAE_farma)
    ),

    WIS_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(WIS_far, min_WIS)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{purple}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", WIS_far),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", WIS_far)
    ),

    WIS_Plugin_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(WIS_farma, min_WIS)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{purple}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", WIS_farma),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", WIS_farma)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

row_groups <- forecast_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(
    Model,
    Dependence
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_groups <- forecast_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(
    Model
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

forecast_table_print <- forecast_table %>%
  group_by(
    Model
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      Model,
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    Model,
    Dependence
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependence_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      Dependence,
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Model_show,
    Dependence_show,
    h,
    RMSE_Benchmark_print,
    RMSE_Plugin_print,
    MAE_Benchmark_print,
    MAE_Plugin_print,
    WIS_Benchmark_print,
    WIS_Plugin_print
  )

names(forecast_table_print) <- c(
  "$(p,d,q)$",
  "$(\\psi,\\nu)$",
  "$h$",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin"
)

latex_table <- forecast_table_print %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c(
      "c", "c", "c",
      "r", "r",
      "r", "r",
      "r", "r"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Averaged forecasting results for the ideal FARFIMA setting with $T=1000$ ",
      "under the expanding-window scheme. ",
      "The FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$ model is used as the benchmark. ",
      "The smallest RMSE within each setting is highlighted in red, ",
      "the smallest MAE in blue, and the smallest WIS in purple. ",
      "WIS combines the 80\\% and 95\\% prediction intervals."
    ),
    label = "tab:ideal_forecast_expanding"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 3,
      "RMSE" = 2,
      "MAE" = 2,
      "WIS" = 2
    ),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "repeat_header",
    font_size = 8
  )

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(row_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  if (!(row_groups$end[i] %in% model_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(
        row_groups$end[i],
        extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){2-9}"
      )
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(model_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  latex_table <- latex_table %>%
    row_spec(
      model_groups$end[i],
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule"
    )
}

cat("\\setlength\\LTleft{\\fill}\n")
cat("\\setlength\\LTright{\\fill}\n")
cat(latex_table)
```







### Plots for ECP
```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

make_ecp_summary <- function(df,
                             alpha_show = 0.05,
                             window_show = "Expanding") {
  make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show) %>%
    filter(method %in% c("far", "farma"), window_type == window_show) %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(
        method,
        levels = c("far", "farma"),
        labels = c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Plugin forecast")
      ),

      T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
      window_type = droplevels(window_type)
    )
}

make_ecp_summary <- function(df,
                             alpha_show = 0.05,
                             window_show = "Expanding") {
  make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show) %>%
    filter(method %in% c("far", "farma"), window_type == window_show) %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(
        method,
        levels = c("far", "farma"),
        labels = c("FAR(1)", "FARFIMA")
      ),

      T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
      window_type = droplevels(window_type)
    )
}

method_cols_ecp <- c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = "#1B9E77",
                     "Plugin forecast" = "#D95F02")

get_T_shapes_ecp <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  if (length(T_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_T_ltys_ecp <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(ltys)) {
    stop("Not enough line types for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

make_ecp_legend_no_window <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(method = droplevels(method), T_factor = droplevels(T_factor))

  method_levels <- levels(df_use$method)
  T_levels <- levels(df_use$T_factor)

  x_title <- 0
  x_item_start <- 3.0
  item_gap <- 3.9
  line_length <- 0.75
  text_gap <- 0.45

  method_df <- tibble(
    method = factor(method_levels, levels = method_levels),

    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(method_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    y = 1.00,
    label = method_levels
  )

  T_df <- tibble(
    T_factor = factor(T_levels, levels = T_levels),

    x_start = x_item_start +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    x_end = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    x_text = x_item_start +
      line_length +
      text_gap +
      (seq_along(T_levels) - 1) * item_gap,

    y = 0.55,
    label = paste0("T = ", T_levels)
  )

  xmax <- max(c(method_df$x_text + 2.2, T_df$x_text + 1.8), na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 1.00,
      label = "Method",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = method_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        colour = method
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = method_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, colour = method),
      size = legend_point_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = method_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_title,
      y = 0.55,
      label = "Sample size T",
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_title_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = T_df,
      aes(
        x = x_start,
        xend = x_end,
        y = y,
        yend = y,
        linetype = T_factor
      ),
      linewidth = legend_line_width,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_end, y = y, shape = T_factor),
      size = legend_point_size,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = T_df,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      size = legend_text_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df_use)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_T_ltys_ecp(df_use)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax),
                    ylim = c(0.35, 1.15),
                    clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

plot_ecp_one_model <- function(df,
                               model_show,
                               title = NULL,
                               alpha_show = 0.05,
                               y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }

  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)

  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]

  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      group = interaction(method, T_factor),
      colour = method,
      linetype = T_factor,
      shape = T_factor
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1 - alpha_show,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_T_ltys_ecp(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
      labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),

      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),

      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )

  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }

  g
}

combine_four_ecp_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                models,
                                                titles,
                                                alpha_show = 0.05,
                                                file_name = NULL,
                                                width = 16,
                                                height = 12,
                                                y_limits = NULL,
                                                y_axis_label = "Empirical coverage probability") {
  if (length(models) != 4) {
    stop("`models` must contain exactly four model labels.")
  }

  if (length(titles) != 4) {
    stop("`titles` must contain exactly four plot titles.")
  }

  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) %in% models)

  if (nrow(df_use) == 0) {
    stop("No observations remain for the requested models.")
  }

  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_use$ECP, 1 - alpha_show), na.rm = TRUE)

    pad <- 0.04 * diff(y_range)

    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.03
    }

    y_limits <- range(c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad), na.rm = TRUE)

    y_limits[1] <- max(0, y_limits[1])

    y_limits[2] <- min(1, y_limits[2])
  }

  legend <- make_ecp_legend_no_window(df_use)

  p1 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[1],
    title = titles[1],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p2 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[2],
    title = titles[2],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p3 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[3],
    title = titles[3],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p4 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[4],
    title = titles[4],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")

  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      y_axis_label,
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)

  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )

  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }

  final_plot
}
```

### Plots for Score ratio

```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

make_interval_plot_summary <- function(df, alpha_show = 0.05) {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need a `T` or `n` column.")
  }

  if (!is.null(alpha_show) && !"alpha" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Cannot find the `alpha` column.")
  }

  if (!"method" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Cannot find the `method` column.")
  }

  df_use <- df

  if (!is.null(alpha_show)) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      filter(abs(as.numeric(alpha) - alpha_show) < 1e-10)
  }

  df_use %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),

      method = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(method)), "farma") ~ "farma",

        str_detect(tolower(as.character(method)), "far\\(1\\)|far1|far_1|far$") ~ "far",

        TRUE ~ tolower(as.character(method))
      ),

      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",

        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",

        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),

      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),

      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),

      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")),

      model_label = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ as.character(model)
      ),

      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),

      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      )))
    )
}

get_T_cols <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  cols <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(cols)) {
    stop("Not enough colours for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(cols[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

make_forecast_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  make_forecast_legend_manual_core(df)
}

make_score_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                     alpha_show = 0.05,
                                     score_col = "Score") {
  df_use <- make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show)

  if (!score_col %in% names(df_use)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find score column:", score_col))
  }

  score_summary <- df_use %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      T_factor,
      h,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      window_type,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(score_value = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = score_value)

  if (!"farma" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FARMA score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }

  if (!"far" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FAR(1) score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }

  score_summary %>%
    mutate(score_ratio = farma / far)
}

plot_score_ratio_one_model <- function(df,
                                       model_show,
                                       title = NULL,
                                       y_limits = NULL) {
  plot_forecast_ratio_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = model_show,
    title = title,
    value_col = "score_ratio",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
}

combine_four_score_ratio_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                        models,
                                                        titles,
                                                        file_name = NULL,
                                                        width = 16,
                                                        height = 12,
                                                        y_limits = NULL,
                                                        y_axis_label = "Interval score ratio") {
  combine_four_forecast_models_shared_axes(
    df = df,
    models = models,
    titles = titles,
    file_name = file_name,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    y_limits = y_limits,
    value_col = "score_ratio",
    y_axis_label = y_axis_label
  )
}
```

```{r}
    "FARFIMA(1,1,1)"
  ),
  file_name = "Forecasting/Sim Plots Ideal/forecast_score_ratio_80_2x2.pdf",
  width = 16,
  height = 14,
  y_axis_label = "Interval score ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)"
)

```


### Plot of weighted interval score ratio

The WIS combines the 80\% and 95\% prediction intervals with the absolute
error of the point forecast. Values below one favour the FARFIMA model over
the FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$ benchmark.

```{r}
make_ideal_wis_ratio_data <- function(df) {
  required_cols <- c(
    "n",
    "h",
    "ar_strength",
    "ma_strength",
    "p_true",
    "q_true",
    "window_type",
    "method",
    "WIS"
  )

  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Missing required WIS columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0L || any(!is.finite(df$WIS))) {
    stop("WIS data must be non-empty and finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      method = case_when(
        method == "farma" ~ "farma",
        method == "far" ~ "far",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),
      model = factor(
        paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
        levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
      ),
      model_label = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      )))
    )

  if (anyNA(out$method) ||
      anyNA(out$window_type) || anyNA(out$model)) {
    stop("Unknown method, window, or model in WIS data.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      T_factor,
      h,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      window_type,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(WIS = mean(WIS), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = WIS)

  if (!all(c("far", "farma") %in% names(out))) {
    stop("Missing FAR or FARMA WIS.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(score_ratio = farma / far)

  if (any(!is.finite(out$score_ratio))) {
    stop("WIS ratios must be finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out
}

wis_ratio <- make_ideal_wis_ratio_data(ideal_wis)

p_wis_ratio <- combine_four_score_ratio_models_shared_axes(
  df = wis_ratio,
  models = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)"),
  titles = c(
    "FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
    "FARFIMA(0,1,1)",
    "FARFIMA(2,1,0)",
    "FARFIMA(1,1,1)"
  ),
  file_name = "Forecasting/Sim Plots Ideal/forecast_wis_ratio_2x2.pdf",
  width = 16,
  height = 14,
  y_axis_label = "WIS ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)"
)

p_wis_ratio
```




### Table of interval forecasting scores

```{r}
ideal_interval <- forecast_res$interval_summary %>%
  filter(
    window_type == "expanding",
    alpha %in% c(0.05, 0.20),
    h %in% c(1, 5, 10)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = paste0("$(", p_true, ",1,", q_true, ")$"),
    Dependence = paste0("$(", ar_strength, ",", ma_strength, ")$"),
    CP = case_when(
      alpha == 0.05 ~ "95\\%",
      alpha == 0.20 ~ "80\\%"
    ),
    method = case_when(
      method == "far" ~ "Benchmark",
      method == "farma" ~ "Plugin",
      TRUE ~ method
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    n,
    p_true,
    q_true,
    ar_strength,
    ma_strength,
    Model,
    Dependence,
    alpha,
    CP,
    h,
    method,
    ECP,
    CPD,
    Score
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = c(ECP, CPD, Score)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    n,
    p_true,
    q_true,
    ar_strength,
    ma_strength,
    alpha,
    h
  )

ideal_interval <- ideal_interval %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    min_CPD = min(
      c(CPD_Benchmark, CPD_Plugin),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    min_Score = min(
      c(Score_Benchmark, Score_Plugin),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    ECP_Benchmark_print = sprintf("%.3f", ECP_Benchmark),

    ECP_Plugin_print = sprintf("%.3f", ECP_Plugin),

    CPD_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(CPD_Benchmark, min_CPD)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.3f", CPD_Benchmark),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.3f", CPD_Benchmark)
    ),

    CPD_Plugin_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(CPD_Plugin, min_CPD)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.3f", CPD_Plugin),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.3f", CPD_Plugin)
    ),

    Score_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(Score_Benchmark, min_Score)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.3f", Score_Benchmark),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.3f", Score_Benchmark)
    ),

    Score_Plugin_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(Score_Plugin, min_Score)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.3f", Score_Plugin),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.3f", Score_Plugin)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cp_groups <- ideal_interval %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model,
    Dependence,
    CP
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dep_groups <- ideal_interval %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model,
    Dependence
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_groups <- ideal_interval %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_groups <- ideal_interval %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(n) %>%
  summarise(
    end = max(row_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ideal_interval_print <- ideal_interval %>%
  group_by(n) %>%
  mutate(
    T_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      as.character(n),
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      Model,
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model,
    Dependence
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependence_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      Dependence,
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    n,
    Model,
    Dependence,
    CP
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CP_show = ifelse(
      row_number() == 1,
      CP,
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    T_show,
    Model_show,
    Dependence_show,
    CP_show,
    h,
    ECP_Benchmark_print,
    ECP_Plugin_print,
    CPD_Benchmark_print,
    CPD_Plugin_print,
    Score_Benchmark_print,
    Score_Plugin_print
  )

names(ideal_interval_print) <- c(
  "$T$",
  "$(p,d,q)$",
  "$(\\psi,\\nu)$",
  "CP",
  "$h$",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin",
  "Benchmark",
  "Plugin"
)

latex_table <- ideal_interval_print %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c(
      "c", "c", "c", "c", "c",
      "r", "r",
      "r", "r",
      "r", "r"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Averaged interval forecasting results for the ideal FARFIMA setting ",
      "under the expanding-window scheme. Results are reported for nominal ",
      "coverage probabilities of 95\\% and 80\\%. ",
      "The FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$ model is used as the benchmark. ",
      "The smallest CPD within each setting is highlighted in red, ",
      "and the smallest interval score is highlighted in blue."
    ),
    label = "tab:ideal_interval_expanding"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 5,
      "ECP" = 2,
      "CPD" = 2,
      "Score" = 2
    ),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "repeat_header",
    font_size = 8
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cp_groups) - 1)) {
  if (!(cp_groups$end[i] %in% dep_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(
        cp_groups$end[i],
        extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){4-11}"
      )
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(dep_groups) - 1)) {
  if (!(dep_groups$end[i] %in% model_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(
        dep_groups$end[i],
        extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){3-11}"
      )
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(model_groups) - 1)) {
  if (!(model_groups$end[i] %in% n_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(
        model_groups$end[i],
        extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){2-11}"
      )
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(n_groups) - 1)) {
  latex_table <- latex_table %>%
    row_spec(
      n_groups$end[i],
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule"
    )
}

cat("\\setlength\\LTleft{\\fill}\n")
cat("\\setlength\\LTright{\\fill}\n")
cat(latex_table)
```
